claims.claim: Registers interactive /review and /review-fix commands and restores extension state from session entries.
Resolves free-form, diff, GitHub pull-request, and GitLab merge-request targets without a branch checkout step.
Starts an investigation pass that produces a review prompt, then starts the final review with that prompt.
Blocks edit and write calls during the prompt-generation investigation pass.
Makes prompt-finalization and finding-recording tools active only in their matching workflow states.
Requires a matching active investigation run before recording the generated review prompt as a session entry.
Records structured review findings with priority and optional source references as session entries.
Collapses the investigation branch, opens the generated prompt for editing, and starts the final review only after handoff succeeds.
Collapses completed review and fix branches and appends their summaries to the session.
Loads optional REVIEW_GUIDELINES.md only when it is a regular file within the 64 KiB bound.
Ships a standalone pi-review launcher that opens Pi with the package and preloads the /review command.
